how: Inner West Ultimate runs seasonal social leagues for all skill levels from Tempe and Earlwood with free beginner sessions before each league; Sydney Uni Ultimate Frisbee Club also competes.
Crossover Dance Studio teaches weekly breaking classes alongside hip hop and K-pop, with casual single-class passes.
The Sydney Flamenco Studio in Chippendale runs classes for all levels, and Bondi Flamenco holds casual beginner classes near Town Hall.
A Marrickville studio runs Level 1 beginner flameworking glass classes and taster sessions that are bookable through City of Sydney What's On and ClassBento.
Many escape room venues operate in the CBD and suburbs, including Next Level Escape, The Cipher Room in St Peters and Scram in Parramatta.
Kingpin Darling Harbour has 20 lanes and a bar, with further alleys such as Tenpin City in Lidcombe and AMF centres; Sydney Rams run a social league.
Several GAA clubs field men's and women's Gaelic football, hurling and camogie in Sydney, including Michael Cusacks, Cormac McAnallen's, Clan Na Gael and Young Ireland.
Spitfire Paintball in Concord and Die Hard Indoor Paintball in Turrella offer urban-style indoor paintball; larger outdoor parks near Camden lie beyond the metro area.
Darling Square Library in Haymarket has a makerspace with 3D printers and runs 3D printing workshops and open Makertime sessions for ages 16 and up.
Callanan Academy of Dance teaches adult Irish dance in Surry Hills, and the Sydney Irish Ceili Dancers hold step and set dancing every Thursday in Kingsgrove during term.
Beginner adult tap classes run through ClassBento (Lindfield), Sydney Community College (Birchgrove), and Sydney Dance Company's adult program.
Ruchi Sanghi Enterprize teaches Kathak from beginner to professional level, and Swastik Institute of Dance in Harris Park also offers Kathak.
Nrityasagara School of Dance in Glenhaven teaches Kalakshetra-style Bharatanatyam in group and private classes for different ages and levels.
Sydney Uni Sport runs social netball competitions on Sundays, Tuesdays and Wednesdays at its Darlington centre, open to community members.
The Sydney Go Club in Surry Hills has a professional in residence and runs monthly beginner classes, and the University of Sydney Go Society welcomes novices.
Waverley Amateur Radio Society (formed 1919) and Manly-Warringah Radio Society operate in Sydney, and Amateur Radio NSW provides licence training.
Sydney Community College runs a one-day Ikebana workshop on Japanese flower arranging at its Rozelle visual arts studio.
Sydney Community College runs a DIY Chinese Dumpling Making workshop in its Rozelle kitchen.
Sydney Community College runs Tai Chi courses for beginners and continuers in Rozelle.
Sydney Community College runs a Calm Mind meditation course for beginners in Rozelle.
Sydney Community College runs Fermenting and Pickling workshops in its Rozelle kitchen.
Sydney Community College runs Gentle Yoga for Wellness courses in Rozelle and a free Hatha yoga intro workshop.
Tufttea Studio in North Strathfield runs a 4-hour Tufting 101 class, and Biu Biu Studio and other studios run beginner tufting classes via ClassBento.
Robots And Dinosaurs is a Sydney hackerspace with a laser cutter, open to first-time visitors for free on Saturdays and available through paid membership.
City of Sydney libraries offer a laser cutting service at Darling Square Library for members, and Robots And Dinosaurs hackerspace has a laser cutter.
AAPES in Botany is a warehouse parkour and freerunning gym with year-round classes including first-timers sessions, and Ninja Parc in South Granville also runs parkour classes.
UNSW Lacrosse Club trains on Wednesday nights and plays in the Sydney Lacrosse League, with NSW Lacrosse based in Kingsford.
Newington Armory at Sydney Olympic Park has a free 18-basket disc golf course with discs available at the Visitor Centre, plus Whalan Reserve in Blacktown and Sefton Golf Course.
Orienteering NSW clubs run weekly beginner-friendly events including the Sydney Summer Series, Saturday Orienteering Series and the Sydney MetrO League in parks and bushland.
Bondi Bowling Club offers walk-in social bowls and Chatswood Bowling Club lends bowls to newcomers, with many other clubs across Sydney.
Studio Pilates on Bathurst Street offers 40-minute reformer classes through the day, alongside other CBD studios such as PilatesBarre and City Physio & Pilates.
Manly Dam, Old Man's Valley in Hornsby and Cascades Trail in Garigal National Park offer marked mountain bike trails across skill levels.
The Sydney Rockclimbing Club (Sydney Rockies) and Sydney Uni Rockclimbing and Mountaineering Club run outdoor trips to local crags and the Blue Mountains for all skill levels.
Sydney Community College runs a Home Beer Brewing for Beginners workshop series, and Country Brewer in Prospect gives home brew lessons.
AIE Sydney has hosted a Global Game Jam site since 2009, and SXSW Sydney runs an annual game jam.
Hack Club's Daydream runs a game-making hackathon for ages 13 to 18 in Kensington, and SXSW Sydney runs a remote game jam.
1989 Arcade Bar in Newtown, B. Lucky & Sons at the Entertainment Quarter and Fortress Sydney in the CBD offer retro arcade and pinball games.
Hyper Reality at the Entertainment Quarter has a VR arena for up to eight players, and VR Kingdom and Entermission in the CBD offer VR games and escape rooms.
The Roasting Club in Mascot runs hands-on roasting workshops on commercial equipment, and a guided tour with a roasting demo and cupping visits two Sydney roasteries.
Sydney Community College runs Massage Course for Beginners (levels 1 and 2) at its Rozelle campus.
